name: Brothers And Sisters
overview: Scripture highlights the importance of honoring family relationships, as seen in the command to honor father and mother, which is foundational to a long and blessed life (Exodus 20:12; Matthew 19:19). The reality of estrangement within families is acknowledged, yet believers are called to embody love and unity as brothers and sisters in Christ. This love is rooted in the salvation offered through faith in Jesus, the only name by which we are saved (John 3:36; Acts 4:12), and is expressed through sincere care and support among fellow believers.
